en.text: Direct, personal access to God. Not through rituals, gatekeepers, or payments.

Covenant Access is consent + alignment: you give God willing access to your heart and life, and God walks with you in truth without distortion. It restores what fear and distortion broke — your simple, steady walk with God. Clarity instead of confusion, love instead of striving, freedom instead of control.
Anyone willing to be honest. Not perfect — willing. The door opens to sincerity, not performance.

en.text: A blueprint for deeper union with God.

A framework for soul attunement, not a checklist. Each soul has custom variations — some are tested in romance, some in betrayal, some in illness, some in abundance. But these five stages repeat, with personalized puzzles coded to your story.

en.text: Radical honesty: "Where have I pretended to be okay?" Journaling confessions not to others — but to God. Sit in silence, let the pain surface without distraction.

zh.text: 彻底诚实：“我在哪里假装自己没事？”把忏悔写进日志，不是向别人，而是向神。安静坐着，让痛苦浮现，不用分心来压住它。

ja.text: 徹底した正直さ：「私はどこで平気なふりをしてきた？」告白を他者ではなく神に向けて日記に書く。静かに座り、気をそらさず痛みが浮かぶままにする。

ko.text: 철저한 정직: "나는 어디에서 괜찮은 척했는가?" 고백을 다른 사람에게가 아니라 하나님께 일기로 쓰세요. 조용히 앉아 산만함 없이 고통이 떠오르게 두세요.

fr.text: Honnêteté radicale : « Où ai-je fait semblant d’aller bien ? » Écrivez vos confessions dans votre journal, non aux autres — mais à Dieu. Asseyez-vous en silence et laissez la douleur remonter sans distraction.

de.text: Radikale Ehrlichkeit: „Wo habe ich so getan, als wäre alles in Ordnung?“ Schreibe Bekenntnisse ins Journal — nicht an andere, sondern an Gott. Sitze in Stille und lass den Schmerz ohne Ablenkung auftauchen.

es.text: Honestidad radical: «¿Dónde he fingido estar bien?» Escribe confesiones en el diario, no para otros, sino para Dios. Siéntate en silencio y deja que el dolor salga a la superficie sin distracciones.
